title: duranta repens var. microphylla
intro: Duranta repens var. microphylla, commonly known as the Gold Mound Duranta, is a compact shrub native to Central and South America. This plant is rich in various health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Duranta repens var. microphylla include its potential to treat anxiety, insomnia, and other sleep disorders due to its sedative and anxiolytic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
